commands.description: Displays the list of all available commands and utility manuals.
Check if the bot instance is active, and shows dynamic system specs.
Ask the integrated Gemini AI to answer questions or write code snippets.
Bans/kicks a malicious user from the group. (Requires admin).
Fetches and displays a funny programmer meme from Reddit API.
Start a fast-paced chat trivia game with currency awards.

  "sessionName": "guru_session",

plugins.name: Gemini Auto-Responder
plugins.description: Enables real-time, smart context-aware conversational chat responses using Google Gemini Flash.
plugins.author: GURU team

plugins.name: Anti-Link System
plugins.description: Instantly delete and ban users who send promotional links, telegram channels, or group invites.
plugins.author: SecOps-Admin

plugins.name: Economy Leveling System
plugins.description: Gamify your community chats! Users earn coins, exp, levels, and ranks by sending active messages.
plugins.author: RPG-Core

plugins.name: Welcome Greet Cards
plugins.description: Generates gorgeous visual background greeting image cards dynamically when a new user joins a group.
